title: Comprehensive throughput & latency benchmarks for FP8/INT8 quantized variants (batching + long-context)
text:
Comprehensive throughput & latency benchmarks for FP8/INT8 quantized variants (batching + long-context)

description:
Goal: Produce definitive throughput and latency benchmarks comparing float32 baseline to FP8 and INT8 quantized variants across representative workloads that highlight interactions with batching and long-context scenarios. This ticket consolidates benchmark design, calibration workflow validation, accuracy vs perf trade-offs, and automated test pipelines so PM, SRE, and Model Onboarding teams can make rollout decisions for quantized runtime defaults.

Scope:
- Model family: Llama-style decoder-only 7B and 70B (or closest available internal variants).
- Quant formats: FP8 (E4M3 and E5M2 if supported) and INT8 symmetric/asymmetric profiles used in our compile stack.
- Calibration: per-layer activation calibration using representative prompt corpus; evaluate static vs dynamic calibration artifacts.
- Workloads: single-request low-latency (batch=1), small-batch throughput (batch sizes 2,4,8), large-batch throughput (batch sizes 16,32), and mixed-concurrency synthetic load.
- Context lengths: short (128 tokens), medium (1024 tokens), long (8192 tokens) to exercise KV cache behavior and attention kernel choices.
- Metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec throughput, GPU utilization, memory footprint, tail variance, and % generation quality regressions measured by standardized evaluation prompts (perplexity delta + BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim similarity on targeted prompts).
- Environment: dedicated runtime nodes with identical driver/kernel builds; tests run on both A100-80GB and H100-80GB where available.
- Deliverables: reproducible benchmark scripts, calibration artifacts, a results dashboard snapshot, and a recommendation doc with safe rollout knobs (e.g., fallback to FP16 for long-contexts, max batch sizes per quant profile).

acceptance_criteria:
Benchmark scripts that can be run end-to-end with a single invocation and produce CSV/JSON outputs for all metrics
Calibration workflow documented and checked in: scripts to generate calibration tables, reproducible seeds, and validation harness
Latency and throughput results for all combinations: model (7B/70B) x quant (FP32, FP8 variants, INT8 variants) x batch sizes x context lengths on at least one GPU type
Quality validation: generation-quality regressions measured and summarized; any profile with >2% average semantic similarity drop flagged
Performance dashboard link with visualization and raw artifacts uploaded to S3/benchmarks/eng/ENG-9482/
Clear rollout recommendation with guardrails (e.g., disable FP8 for >4096 context or batch >16 for model X)

tasks:
Design benchmark matrix and finalize combinations (owner: Mason)
Implement calibration pipeline and seed corpus extraction (owner: Sonia Ramos)
Build runner that enumerates configs and records GPU counters (owner: Infra team)
Run short smoke runs for stability and cost estimate (owner: Mason)
Execute full sweep for 7B on A100 and H100 (owner: Bench team)
Execute selected 70B runs for long-context/low-batch corner cases (owner: Bench team)
Aggregate results, compute quality deltas, and populate dashboard (owner: Mason)
Draft rollout guidance and present to PM/Runtime/Model-Onboarding (owner: Mason)
Create CI job to run abbreviated benchmarks on each runtime patch (owner: CI team)

notes:
Trade-offs: FP8 E5M2 yields better dynamic range but may change attention kernel selection impacting latency for long-context. INT8 is stable for small contexts but needs careful per-channel scaling on weights to avoid hallucination rate increases.
Calibration corpus: we will reuse the 'eval-commonsense-2025' prompt set augmented with domain-specific prompts from customer telemetry (sanitized). Representative distributions should match production token histograms (avg len, prefix patterns).
We should baseline with deterministic generation (sampling off) for perplexity and quality comparisons; include a small set of stochastic samples to measure real-world divergence.
Batching interaction: continuous batching in the runtime may increase throughput but can exacerbate tail latency when KV cache hits lead to uneven sequence lengths. Add scatter plots of batch composition vs latency in dashboard.
Long-context risks: quantization noise can accumulate in KV caches; we need to measure generation drift after extended context conditioning (>4096 tokens). If large drift observed, recommend fallback heuristics or mixed-precision KV cache.
Cost estimate: full sweep is estimated ~120 GPU-hours for 7B on A100 across configs; coordinate with capacity planning to reserve nodes under 'bench-sprint-03'.

comments:
2026-03-10 Mason Clark: Kickoff — drafted matrix and initial hypothesis. Proposed focusing 70B on critical corner cases to save GPU hours.
2026-03-11 Sonia Ramos: Implemented calibration tooling prototype. Early INT8 symmetric profiles look promising but produced a small perplexity bump on code-like prompts.
2026-03-11 Infra team (notes): Added GPU telemetry collector to runner; exposing SM utilization and clock throttling metrics. Running smoke tests today.
2026-03-12 PR #7420: bench/quant: add benchmark enumerator and CSV exporter. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7420
2026-03-12 PM review (Lena Martinez): Please ensure the recommendation explicitly calls out safety for regulated customers—prefer INT8 conservative defaults until validated.
2026-03-13 Mason Clark: First 7B runs completed for batch sizes 1/4/16 on A100 for FP32 and FP8 E4M3. Initial summary attached to S3. Observed 1.8x tokens/sec gain at batch=16 for FP8 with 0.6% avg embedding-similarity drop.
2026-03-13 Sonia Ramos: Uploaded calibration artifacts to gs://redwood-bench/calib/ENG-9482/. Calibration uses 5k representative sequences; manifest and seed included.
2026-03-13 Security (Arjun Singh): Reviewed artifacts, no PII detected in corpus. Recommend adding automated scrub step for future runs.
